window_boundary: half_open_start_inclusive_end_exclusive_America_New_York_calendar_dates; translate to UTC for interfaces with UTC timestamps
task_order: for each window in listed order, rotate NVDA MU MSFT; never select windows by returns or search results

scoring.language: English only; no Chinese machine translation in main scores
scoring.semantic_review_selection: before model scores or return access: source then symbol then content type then (published_at,article_id,version), take first 30

factor_protocol.N1: mean net tone of distinct article event clusters per company at daily signal cutoff; no archive completeness claim
factor_protocol.N2: number of distinct article event clusters per company at daily signal cutoff; missing coverage remains missing
factor_protocol.primary_label: next eligible session open to following session open, after scored_at and frozen cutoff
factor_protocol.secondary_label: five eligible sessions, purged across time split
factor_protocol.signal_cutoff: 16:00 America/New_York regular-session close; only already scored content eligible
factor_protocol.entry: first subsequent regular-session open after cutoff with approved price and corporate-action evidence
factor_protocol.split: chronological train validation future test; overlap labels purged
